scope: Every active internal requirement has structural validation and per-ID definition/evidence-contract desk review. Forty-seven initially autonomous entries received focused detector/scope/action review; all 643 current human entries received separate ASVS or PCI/unaligned desk review. Runtime or customer conformance is not asserted for human requirements.
semantic_review_limits: All 687 active identities have structural and per-ID desk review of persisted criterion, instructions, applicability and check role/proof/argument binding. Desk review is distinct from executing or assessing each requirement on a customer deployment.

The 47 initially autonomous entries received detector-specific source and fixture review; 44 retain explicit bounded automation and three broad payment requirements retain independent human evidence. This is not a complete runtime penetration test or external compliance certificate.

All 643 current human definitions were desk-reviewed: 344 ASVS-aligned and 299 PCI/unaligned. Original standard clauses, exceptions and intervals are preserved; source extraction was not independently recertified. Three concrete persisted-source inconsistencies were corrected.

Forty-four mandatory heuristic obligations were changed to supporting after per-ID review. Optional collection gaps remain visible as technical evidence with actions, while the human result is preserved. A genuinely necessary verified counterexample or unresolved applicability retains its existing semantics.

Default profiles hide genuine human requirements unless the human flag or explicit selection is provided. Collection errors remain separate from confirmed vulnerability findings; supporting observations never by themselves prove full human-required conformance.

review.evidence: FilesystemCheck::strictNoWorldWritable
review.automated_scope: Unix other-write bit is absent throughout traversed deployment entries.
review.limitations_and_false_result_risks: ACLs and actual PHP process privileges are outside this predicate. Symlink targets are deliberately unassessed and produce collection diagnostics.
review.client_action: Inspect the reported exact path and owner; remove only inappropriate other-write permission. Resolve unreadable or symlink paths before claiming coverage.

review.evidence: FilesystemCheck::fileModeMax,fileOwnerGroupMatches
review.automated_scope: env.php permission bits are a subset of 0640 and UID/GID equal configured owner/group references.
review.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Matching project-root ownership is a deployment policy, not universal Magento security truth. Custom shared group ownership may differ legitimately. ACL restrictions are not assessed.
review.client_action: Inspect only app/etc/env.php and configured ownership references. Configure legitimate reference paths rather than recursively chown/chmod the application.

review.evidence: DeploymentStateCheck::webrootArtifacts
review.automated_scope: Forbidden artifact basenames are absent throughout readable pub tree, following resolvable project-contained symlinks.
review.limitations_and_false_result_risks: External or unresolved symlinks cannot be silently clean. This does not establish live HTTP reachability or arbitrary backup formats.
review.client_action: Remove the identified artifact from pub; inspect external links and restore traversal/read permission for exact incomplete paths.

review.evidence: CodeQueryChecks::strictPhpSuperglobals
review.automated_scope: No configured direct superglobal T_VARIABLE tokens in valid PHP under app.
review.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Dynamic variable references and broader input-validation correctness are outside scope. Syntax/read/link gaps cannot pass; comments and literal strings are ignored.
review.client_action: Use Magento request abstractions at reported file/line. Resolve parse or read failures separately, without treating them as vulnerabilities.

review.criterion: Valid PHP files in the configured app subtree contain no T_VARIABLE references to $_GET, $_POST, $_REQUEST, $_COOKIE, $_FILES or $_SERVER. Comments and literal strings are ignored. This is a source coding policy, not proof of input validation.

review.evidence: CodeQueryChecks::strictLiteralMixedContent
review.automated_scope: No literal insecure HTTP subresource or form-action references in selected markup/CSS.
review.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Dynamic JS URLs and live responses are outside scope. No eligible readable source is a collection limitation rather than proof of secure assets.
review.client_action: Replace the reported literal with the correct HTTPS resource. Supply readable markup/CSS source or assess the runtime response separately.

review.evidence: FilesystemCheck::diCompiled,countPhpFiles
review.automated_scope: At least one readable generated PHP artifact exists in each configured generated directory.
review.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Prior countPhpFiles counted unreadable PHP as readable artifacts, producing false PASS. Fixed. Presence does not prove freshness or compilation correctness.
review.client_action: Generate DI artifacts during the deployment build. If artifacts exist but cannot be read, grant scanner read access to the exact generated subtree.

review.criterion: At least one readable PHP artifact exists in each configured generated/metadata and generated/code directory. This assesses artifact presence, not DI compilation correctness or freshness.

review.evidence: FilesystemCheck::strictStaticContentPresence
review.automated_scope: At least one nonempty readable published frontend/admin static artifact is present.
review.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Presence is existential, so some unrelated unreadable artifacts need not invalidate an observed readable artifact. This is not every theme/locale completeness.
review.client_action: Publish static assets during deployment; inspect the configured static directory and permissions when nothing readable is observed.

review.evidence: DeploymentStateCheck::cacheTypeEnabled
review.automated_scope: Collected app/etc/env.php cache_types.full_page is explicitly enabled.
review.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Declared cache type state does not prove functioning cache backend, hit ratio, Varnish gateway or all runtime routes. Missing/malformed deployed state is a collection limitation, not automatically disabled cache.
review.client_action: If explicitly disabled, enable the Full Page Cache type through the deployed Magento configuration workflow. If state is absent, collect Magento cache:status or the persisted readable deployment state.

review.evidence: FilesystemCheck::indexersReady,DeploymentStateCheck::indexersDatabaseReady
review.automated_scope: Automate against recorded Magento indexer_state, not optional var/.indexer_status file.
review.limitations_and_false_result_risks: The old optional file is not an authoritative runtime source, can be stale, and does not prove backlog absence. Runtime team implements real read-only DB assessment.
review.client_action: Use the deployed DB connection with SELECT permission. Inspect invalid/working indexers and schedule safe reindexing according to operational context.

review.title: Indexers are READY (no backlog)
review.reason: New deployment_indexers_database_ready reads indexer_state; valid rows PASS, working/invalid FAIL readiness, empty or unrecognized rows/query failure are actionable collection errors. Does not assert every extension indexer registered or queue empty.
review.evidence: tests/AutomationConfigRuntimeAuditTest.php: 21 assertions; tests/AdminAclCheckTest.php PASS; tests/BasicDeploymentPoliciesTest.php:14 assertions PASS
FilesystemCheck::strictLogsReportsPlacement
review.automated_scope: Configured log/report paths or their corresponding project symlink targets are absent from collected pub.
review.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Physical placement does not establish actual HTTP exposure. Traversal gaps and unresolved links cannot prove absence.
review.client_action: Move the identified log/report location outside pub or remove its public link. Resolve exact unreadable/link gaps separately.

review.criterion: Within the collected pub tree, no configured var/log or var/report relative path, nor symlink to the corresponding project target, is present. This is filesystem placement, not a live HTTP exposure assertion.

review.evidence: ComposerAdvisoryChecks::auditApi,validateLockScope
review.automated_scope: Applicable advisory matches are absent in the successfully queried configured dataset for collected lock versions.
review.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Cannot establish absence of unknown vulnerabilities or uncollected runtime dependencies. Invalid lock records or malformed API replies cannot pass.
review.client_action: Update reported package through a controlled Composer change; verify advisory-specific patch evidence. For transport failure, verify endpoint/trust/network without disabling certificate validation.

review.evidence: ComposerAdvisoryChecks::adobeSecurityPatchesApi
review.automated_scope: Collected Magento product branch is current or required patches have verified local alternatives.
review.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Only collected Composer version and supported patch response are evaluated; runtime installation and unknown branches are not inferred.
review.client_action: Apply the stated Adobe security release or verify patch evidence in the collected files. Resolve unsupported branch separately from a service/network collection error.

review.evidence: ComposerAdvisoryChecks::transitiveAuditApi
review.automated_scope: Collected transitive lock versions have no returned applicable advisory matches.
review.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Classification depends on valid root manifest and complete lock inventory; advisory dataset scope remains explicit.
review.client_action: Update the vulnerable dependency or requiring parent named in evidence; repair malformed manifest/lock or service connectivity separately.

review.criterion: No transitive package version in the complete collected Composer lock inventory is identified as affected by applicable advisories returned by the configured OSV service. Coverage is limited to the queried inventory and service data.

review.evidence: ComposerAdvisoryChecks::constraintsConflictApi
review.automated_scope: Combined declared constraints intersect versions at or above a returned advisory published fixed version.
review.limitations_and_false_result_risks: This is not full dependency solver feasibility, platform compatibility, or every fixed branch. No-fix advisories do not prove a blocked update.
review.client_action: Adjust the reported root/parent constraint in a controlled dependency update; separately confirm Composer solver and platform compatibility.

review.criterion: For returned applicable advisory findings with published fixed versions, the combined declared dependency constraints intersect versions at or above the published fixed version. This does not establish complete Composer solver feasibility, platform compatibility or every fixed branch.

review.evidence: ComposerVersionChecks::assessCompleteYankedStatuses
review.automated_scope: Every requested installed version has explicit matching non-yanked status.
review.limitations_and_false_result_risks: An empty, partial, unknown, or wrong-version service response cannot pass. Positive withdrawn versions remain failures despite other coverage gaps.
review.client_action: Replace the specifically withdrawn version. If status is missing, verify service coverage for that package/version rather than deleting or upgrading blindly.

review.criterion: Every package version in the complete collected Composer lock inventory has an explicit non-yanked status from the configured package-status source. Missing per-package status cannot establish a clean result.

review.evidence: ComposerAdvisoryChecks::advisoryLatencyApi
review.automated_scope: Affected returned advisory publication age does not exceed configured threshold.
review.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Publication age is not organization discovery time or measured remediation SLA; missing or future publication timestamps cannot pass.
review.client_action: Review the identified affected advisory and update/patch dependency. Request corrected publication metadata when service data is incomplete.

review.criterion: No returned advisory affecting an installed Composer package version has a publication age greater than the configured 30-day threshold. This is publication age, not organizational discovery time or a measured remediation SLA.

review.evidence: ComposerRepositoryChecks::abandonedApi
review.automated_scope: No queried dependency has authoritative known abandoned status.
review.limitations_and_false_result_risks: The duplicated library-subset obligation is redundant but does not duplicate findings. Unknown status must not mean maintained. Abandonment is maintenance policy, not exploitability.
review.client_action: Migrate the named abandoned package to its reported maintained replacement, after compatibility review. Resolve unknown service classification separately.

review.criterion: No dependency package in the complete assessed Composer inventory is marked abandoned by the configured package-maintenance source; a clean conclusion requires explicit known status for every assessed package.

review.evidence: ComposerRepositoryChecks::releaseRecencyApi,assessReleaseRecencyStatuses
review.automated_scope: Every queried package has known latest release time within configured calendar-month threshold.
review.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Missing response previously referenced undefined variables and could yield false PASS. Unavailable history was silently excluded. Fixed; future dates rejected. Old age is maintenance policy, not a vulnerability.
review.client_action: Inspect the named package release history and maintenance need. Missing classification requires service metadata coverage, not an automatic upgrade of every dependency.

review.evidence: ComposerRepositoryChecks::repoArchivedApi,assessRepositoryStatuses
review.automated_scope: Every applicable source repository is explicitly assessed and is not archived, disabled, or missing.
review.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Prior partial response could pass when any repository was active. Strict scope now rejects partial coverage, missing boolean flags, and unsupported providers. Explicit repository_not_applicable remains excluded.
review.client_action: Inspect the specific upstream repository and choose a maintained successor if needed. Ask the status service to collect unsupported/unassessed providers; do not infer archive from transport failure.

review.evidence: ComposerPolicyChecks::jsonConstraints
review.automated_scope: Configured root dependency sections contain no wildcard constraints.
review.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Exact source constraint policy is not proof of insecure dependencies. Project-local manifest prevents unrelated CLI package metadata substituting for target.
review.client_action: Replace only the reported wildcard with a compatible maintained constraint and regenerate/test lock deliberately.

review.evidence: ComposerPolicyChecks::jsonConstraints
review.automated_scope: Configured root dependency sections contain no development branch constraints.
review.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Root-manifest policy does not cover every transitive lock branch; development constraints may be intentional nonproduction exceptions.
review.client_action: Choose a stable compatible package version or document scope-specific development exception; do not label every dev dependency an exploitable flaw.

review.evidence: ComposerPolicyChecks::jsonKv
review.automated_scope: Target composer.json has boolean prefer-stable=true.
review.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Missing prefer-stable may legitimately retain Composer defaults; it violates this declared project policy only, not a vulnerability by itself.
review.client_action: Set prefer-stable=true if adopting the policy and validate dependency resolution; ensure the reported target manifest is readable and valid JSON.

review.evidence: ComposerVersionChecks::directOutdatedApi
review.automated_scope: Collected direct lock versions match reported latest stable versions.
review.limitations_and_false_result_risks: Latest version is maintenance policy; major upgrades may intentionally be constrained. Unknown or unparsable reported versions cannot mean current.
review.client_action: Review reported direct package latest version and compatibility before updating. Do not force major updates from security severity alone.

review.criterion: Collected direct Composer package versions are not older than the latest stable release reported by the configured package-status source. This is a maintenance policy, not proof of an exploitable vulnerability.

review.evidence: ComposerPolicyChecks::lockIntegrity
review.automated_scope: Composer content-hash and dependency identities/provider coverage are consistent.
review.limitations_and_false_result_risks: This does not prove full solver result or installed vendor integrity. Missing lock violates lock policy; existing unreadable lock previously failed as invalid JSON and is now a separate collection error.
review.client_action: Regenerate and review composer.lock in a controlled build using the target manifest. Grant read access if collector cannot access existing files; never silently regenerate production files.

review.criterion: composer.lock has a matching Composer content-hash, no duplicate or malformed package identities, and contains or provides/replaces each declared root package dependency. This does not prove the full dependency solver result or installed vendor file integrity.

review.evidence: GitHistoryCheck::scanGitHistory

review.client_action: Inspect reported commit/path with redacted evidence, rotate a real credential if confirmed, then apply deliberate history cleanup. Deployment scans without Git should use MB-0730.

review.reason: History scope retained globally; deployments without .git use existing working-tree requirement, not false clean history.
